messages.subject: Re: estimator = "MLR" not working
parts:
Aurelie

lavaan is running MLR. But MLR will not show as the estimator, because what MLR means is ML estimation, with robust fit indices and robust standard errors. Which you can see as the "scaled" indices, and "sandwich" standard errors
